resources.string: Ultra environment updated. Restart to apply.
An environment update was already submitted. Restart before trying again (ULTRA_ENV_UPGRADE_REBOOT_REQUIRED).
The environment update was interrupted. Restart and check its status (ULTRA_ENV_UPGRADE_INTERRUPTED).
Environment build update available for %1$s. Tap to update.
Update the environment build of %1$s. The version number stays the same. Restart is required for the update to take effect.
Ultra environment update found: %1$s. Tap to upgrade!
Preparing and upgrading the Ultra environment to %1$s. Do not power off.
Upgrade to %1$s submitted. Restart, then verify the installed version.
Upgrade from %1$s to %2$s.\n\nThis installs over the current environment. The device restarts a few seconds after it succeeds, so save your work first.
Upgrade did not finish. Try again later.
The environment changed. Upgrade is unavailable right now.
Upgrade did not finish: %1$s. See the diagnostic report for details.
